svg.title: Indirect injection and sensitive content
svg.desc: A permitted retrieval can still return content the model should not receive. Verify non-streaming JSON and actual extension findings. Unsupported payloads may bypass sanitization.

g.text: A permitted retrieval can still return content the model should not receive.
ADK plugin screens the clinician prompt
Keep direct-input screening; the egress extension is a separate control.
IAP extension checks identity + tool permission
An allowed tool call is not a blanket approval of the returned document.
Model Armor extension inspects the returned text
Injection profile: planted instructions. Strict profile: synthetic MRN pattern.
Forward allowed content or terminate blocked content
This lab demonstrates inspect-and-block. It does not silently claim redaction.
Verify non-streaming JSON and actual extension findings. Unsupported payloads may bypass sanitization.
